set.body:
PURPOSE

Establish the canonical static StoryAtlas publication target now, over the view artifacts already supplied by storymodel4s. This slice is intentionally provider-independent: it must not wait for the final story-output bundle ADTs, and it must not invent them locally.

SCOPE

- Define a pure, deterministic lowering from the existing NarrativeScene, CodexFlow, and/or PaginatedCodex inputs into the canonical preview.html publication surface.
- Preserve exact DOM text, provider-supplied provenance and coordinates, typed identity descent, requested-layer disposition, textual twins, missingness, and layout/export receipts.
- Keep the richer interactive application a separate product target.
- Provide an adapter seam so a later authorized provider bundle can feed the same publication compiler without changing the static document contract.

EXECUTABLE ACCEPTANCE

- preview.html opens directly from the filesystem and is self-contained HTML/CSS with inline SVG as document content.
- It contains no JavaScript, inline event handlers, external resources, CDN/font dependencies, or fetch dependence on sibling role files.
- Canonical text is selectable DOM text; SVG renderer data-name values remain renderer identities and never become Address.
- Every requested relation layer is rendered, explicitly suppressed with a reason, or recorded as unavailable; no silent drop.
- Output is deterministic for identical input and carries the relevant ViewProvenance and LayoutReceipt checksums.
- Automated source/package assertions and a product-controlled browser court cover direct-file opening, no network requests, keyboard/read order, non-colour semantics, 200 percent zoom, textual-twin parity, and DPR 2 visual inspection.
- The full repository gate passes under the required sibling overrides.

OUT OF SCOPE

Final provider-owned bundle names, feature values, chronology, recall/privacy semantics, and any scientific inference.
set.title: Certify a self-contained static StoryAtlas preview over current view artifacts
